requirements.condition: When implementing the experimental MG resource record.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent MG RDATA as a single MGMNAME field.
requirements.why_checkable: The MG RDATA parser and serializer can be checked for the single-field layout shown in the format diagram.

requirements.quote:
3.3.6. MG RDATA format (EXPERIMENTAL)

    +--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+
    /                   MGMNAME                     /
    /                                               /
    +--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+

where:

MGMNAME         A <domain-name> which specifies a mailbox which is a
                member of the mail group specified by the domain name.
requirements.condition: When implementing the experimental MG resource record.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent the MGMNAME field as a domain name.
requirements.why_checkable: The MGMNAME field representation and its domain-name parsing and serialization are inspectable.

requirements.quote:
3.3.6. MG RDATA format (EXPERIMENTAL)

    +--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+
    /                   MGMNAME                     /
    /                                               /
    +--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+

where:

MGMNAME         A <domain-name> which specifies a mailbox which is a
                member of the mail group specified by the domain name.
requirements.condition: When implementing the experimental MG resource record.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret MGMNAME as the mailbox of a member of the mail group identified by the MG record domain name.
requirements.why_checkable: An MG record can be checked for the mapping from its record domain name to the member mailbox designated by MGMNAME.

requirements.quote:
3.3.6. MG RDATA format (EXPERIMENTAL)

    +--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+
    /                   MGMNAME                     /
    /                                               /
    +--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+

where:

MGMNAME         A <domain-name> which specifies a mailbox which is a
                member of the mail group specified by the domain name.

MG records cause no additional section processing.
requirements.condition: When implementing the experimental MG resource record.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Perform additional-section processing as a consequence of an MG record.
requirements.why_checkable: Processing an MG record can be exercised and inspected to verify that it does not trigger additional-section processing.
